senses.zh_definition: Vardhaan：见于人名的拉丁字母拼写。本条仅说明专名用法，尚未核实其为马来语普通词或 DBP 正式收录词。
senses.en_definition: Vardhaan: an attested spelling of a personal name; not verified here as a Malay common word or an official DBP headword.
senses.ms_definition: Vardhaan ialah ejaan nama orang yang ditemukan dalam penggunaan; statusnya sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu atau entri rasmi DBP belum dapat disahkan. Huraian ini bukan takrif rasmi DBP.
senses.nuances: 词性 noun 在此指专有名词（kata nama khas）。不能把该名字直接译为“祝福”“恩赐”或“增长”；这些释义需要另行核实原语言形式和具体命名背景。下列组合及情境均为编写的用法示例，不代表高频搭配或真实事件。

etymology.historical_story: A documented naming story concerns actor Vardhaan Puri. In a 2024 interview, he explained that he had added an extra “a” to his earlier spelling, Vardhan, for personal numerological reasons. This illustrates how a name’s spelling can reflect individual choice. It does not establish a Malay etymology, a standard pronunciation, or a single historical meaning for every bearer. [Source: The Free Press Journal](https://www.freepressjournal.in/entertainment/vardhaan-puri-on-adding-extra-a-in-his-name-it-will-help-me-in-personal-professional-life-exclusive).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记拼写：var + dh + aa + n。把连续两个 a 当作视觉记号；这只是拼写辅助，不是音节划分、读音说明或词源分析。
